confidence_notes: Six searches (1 RBA, 5 Penang prices); only search-result summaries were read, not full pages. Meal anchors are central estimates from cost-of-living aggregators (Wise, MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, Nomad Ranker) that disagree by 2-3x; ringgit converted at about RM4.2/USD. Coffee fits RM10-12 and beer RM10-20 ranges; cocktail reflects typical RM25-45 bar prices; wine glass is weakest (one undated RM21 house-wine listing) and was set at about 1.8x beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge, with no booking pages or listings inspected. FX is from a search result for the RBA exchange-rate page (18 Nov 2026); an older cached value near 0.72 was treated as stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Penang/George Town priced from Malaysian ringgit aggregator data, cross-checked against general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur and other Malaysian and Southeast Asian tourist cities; far below Singapore.
